source_text: Ut discernant inter sanctum et profanum, mundum et immundum. Doctrinae officium. Nolite iudicare superficiem.
pass_a_gloss: That they-may-distinguish between holy and profane, clean and unclean. Of-teaching office. Do-not judge surface.
pass_b_english: That they may [[distinguish holy and common, clean and unclean >> Bible:Leviticus 10:10]]. That is teaching’s office. Do not judge by surfaces.
